name: Carlisle Bay
insider_take: This pristine all-suite resort sits on one of Antigua's most spectacular beaches, where calm turquoise waters meet powder-soft sand in a protected bay that's perfect for swimming year-round.
whats_special: Carlisle Bay boasts the island's only overwater spa treatment rooms and features a unique tennis academy with flood-lit courts. The resort's location on the leeward side means consistently calm waters, while its 87 suites are among the most spacious in the Caribbean, each with ocean views and private terraces.
pro_tip: Book the Antigua Suite for direct beach access and the largest terrace, or time your visit during turtle nesting season (June-October) when hawksbill turtles come ashore right on the resort's beach.
dont_miss: The resort's private yacht excursions to nearby Bird Island, snorkeling at the pristine Cades Reef just offshore, and sunset cocktails at the beachfront bar where you might spot the occasional celebrity guest who favors this ultra-private retreat.
pros: Pristine white sand beach with crystal-clear Caribbean waters
Spacious suites with contemporary design and ocean views
Multiple dining venues including beachfront and fine dining options
Comprehensive spa and wellness facilities with tropical treatments
cons: Remote island location requires additional travel planning
